messages:
tess: Heads-up: Orion Labs wants to publish in AWS and GCP marketplaces. They asked for our security bundle checklist. Quick split of owners?

raul: I can own artifact ingest. We need: redacted SOC2 Type II or ISO27001 cert, pen-test report (redacted), SIG questionnaire (signed), architecture diagram, cert chain, and KMS/HSM integration notes if present.

anya: Product timeline: aiming for 2026-06-01 listing. We need final artifacts 96h before that for marketing + listing verification. If pen or SOC missing, we can delay by two weeks.

sec-bot: Reminder: pen testers must sign AUP and provide insurance proof. No data exfil clause required. Also require scan screenshots and remediation plan.

raul: Transfer approach: presigned S3 into a scoped folder. We'll require an evidence index CSV with sha256 and redaction level. Example manifest header: file_name,sha256,category,redaction_level

tess: Who does redaction? Partner-redacted preferred. Legal will accept our verification. If partner declines, we can redact but need partner sign-off.

legal-bot: Legal note: attestation template required showing redaction performed and no customer PII included. We'll also need marketing permission language separate.

anya: Can we get an early indicator (yes/no) from security by 2026-05-20 so we can decide whether to push launch?

raul: Yes. I'll set up the bucket and a short-lived presign policy (48-168h). I'll also publish a small verification script that checks manifest checksums and redaction_level presence.

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-ORION-174500 for pen coordination. Add SOW and scope to the ticket.

tess: Great. I'll consolidate owners in the shared doc and ping Orion for SOW and certs. Thanks all.
